_comment: Deploy-artifact size budgets (bytes), enforced by check_deploy_artifact.mts. Re-measured 2026-08-01 (cross-browser durability lane). Runtime WASM 6,264,349 (was 6,086,515): `--merge-similar-functions` was removed from the release wasm-opt flags in rust/chronicle_preprocessing_runtime_wasm/Cargo.toml because merging Salsa 0.28's per-jar `fn() -> TypeId` thunks corrupted jar identity — the second salsa::Storage built inside one WASM instance registered an incomplete jar map and the next singleton-input read aborted with `ingredient JarImpl<UsageSupportInput> was not registered`. Measured on WebKit 26.4 that broke every processing run after the first in a page; the Cargo.toml comment carries the full evidence. Cost +177,834 B uncompressed (gzip essentially unchanged: 1,853.81 kB to 1,853.89 kB). Runtime WASM cap raised 6,100,000 to 6,330,000, .wasm total 8,200,000 to 8,360,000, assets total 11,250,000 to 11,420,000. Worker 127,851 (was 125,840): chronicle-worker.ts now exposes probeWorkspaceCapability and opfsArtifactStore.ts probes a verified OPFS write/read-back round trip instead of mere directory existence, so the fail-closed durable-storage gate runs in the worker that actually writes; worker cap raised 127,000 to 129,000. Prior 2026-07-28 rationale (incremental-execution kernel perf work, compare/View UI) retained in git history. Budgets retain limited headroom; raising one requires a named cause and a new measurement.
